concerns.text: FR-006 mandates MDES calculation via 'swapping top-k positions' (label swapping). The plan.md and T021 describe 'noise injection' (Gaussian perturbation) instead. No task exists to implement the spec-mandated label-swapping algorithm, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.

FR-007 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping alpha values. T024 is the only task addressing this, but it is marked as rejected/missing in the analyze report. There is no active task to deliver the `results/sensitivity/alpha_sweep.csv` artifact required by FR-007.

FR-001 (data download), FR-002 (permutation engine), FR-003 (metric computation), and FR-004 (p-value calc) rely on foundational tasks T004, T005, T006, and T008. These tasks are marked as rejected/missing in the analyze report, meaning no active tasks exist to implement the core infrastructure required for US1.

FR-002, FR-003, and FR-004 require the generation of null distributions and p-values. Tasks T013, T014, T015, T016, and T017 are marked as rejected/missing. Without these, the system cannot produce the outputs required by US1.

FR-005 (BH correction) and FR-006 (MDES) require T021 and T023. These are marked as rejected/missing. Additionally, T026 (corrected p-values) is missing. No active tasks exist to fulfill US2 requirements.

FR-007 requires a sensitivity analysis. T024 is the only task for this, but it is missing. The spec requires reporting the count of queries where significance status changes; no task exists to generate this report.

T021 description states 'swapping top-k positions' in step 2, but the plan.md and T021 summary describe 'noise injection'. This internal contradiction in the task description creates ambiguity about which algorithm to implement, though the spec mandates label swapping.
